document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Hidden behind an ancient glacial moraine, you watch the group 
of gray men hurry past. Once they are long gone, you withdraw 
through the underwood at a tangent to their route.
Make a Luck roll; if you succeed, go to 513; if you fail, go to 67.
